newsitem.title: UK: Sainsbury gains as results top forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Sainsbury gains as results top forecasts.

text.p: Shares in supermarket operator J. Sainsbury Plc rose in pre-market trade on Wednesday after year-end results at the top end of analyst expectations, dealers said.
The stock was up 11-1/2p at 357-1/2 by 0722 GMT in volume of 52,532 shares.
Sainsbury shares plummeted on January 24 after the comapny warned that profits would drop to between 640 million stg and 650 million, well below analyst expectations at that time.

Yet Wednesday's result came in slightly above that range and was coupled with modestly upbeat news on same-store sales and margins. Dealers also noted there was no fresh negative surprise from the company.
"The results were pretty good and there was a bit of relief too," said ond.
Sainsbury posted a 14 percent drop in pre-tax pre-exceptional profit to 651 million stg but said same-store sales were up a relatively robust 4.2 percent in the current year.
The total dividend of 12.3p compared with an expected 12.1p.

In the first seven weeks of the financial year, Sainsbury said petrol margins were higher than last year though this was offset by higher Reward Card and depreciation costs. Margins overall were stable.
